text: Experiment 5, window extensions (2026-11-11), baseline settings (plain grid, [α/Fe] free), 202/202 valid. Each arm is fitted on the galaxies of the 110-galaxy window sample that cover its window and is compared, per galaxy, with arm (i) (4074.5–4666.1 Å). Median paired change, extension − (i): (k) 3742.9–4666.1 Å (adds H10, H9, H8; Ca II H and K stay masked), 60 galaxies, z 0.654–0.984: [α/Fe] −0.18 (16–84 −0.32 to −0.07), age +0.01 Gyr, [Fe/H] +0.02; slope −4.12 [−5.44, −2.73] against (i) −4.59 and (a) −1.47 on the same galaxies (Planck18 line −5.13). (l) 4074.5–4893.0 Å (adds C2 4668 and Hβ), 96 galaxies, z 0.603–0.894: [α/Fe] −0.12 (−0.26 to −0.04), age +0.01 Gyr, [Fe/H] +0.01; slope −4.59 [−5.93, −3.10] against (i) −4.87 and (a) −2.39 (line −5.46). C2 4668 pull in (l) −2.58. (m) 4074.5–5207.9 Å (adds C2 4668, Hβ, Fe5015, Mg b), 46 galaxies, z 0.603–0.750: [α/Fe] −0.16 (−0.29 to −0.00), age −0.96 Gyr (−1.37 to −0.29), [Fe/H] +0.21 (+0.09 to +0.29); the age change has slope +2.15 [+0.45, +3.78] Gyr per unit z; slope −7.23 [−9.91, −4.43] against (i) −9.38 and (a) −4.44 (line −5.92). Pulls in (m): Mg b −2.20, C2 4668 −4.72, Fe5015 −0.05. Window ladder, median [α/Fe]: (a) full range −0.03; (h) 4155–4438 +0.25; (i) 4074.5–4666.1 +0.21; (k) +0.01; (l) +0.10; (m) +0.06. Ages and the slope are unchanged by the blue extension to 3743 Å and by the red extension to 4893 Å; they change when rest 4893–5208 Å is added. The full-range fits of the no-Mg b galaxies also differ from (i) (age +0.84 Gyr in (i) − (a)); the pixels responsible there lie bluer than 3743 Å or between 4893 Å and the red edge and were not isolated. Lead check: slopes and paired medians recomputed from per-fit.csv.
